title: Canonical maps for open restriction of exceptional inverse image
statement: For condensed commutative coefficients Lambda, define the restrictions of exact inverse image and open extension to the recorded localizing full subcategories. Define their open compositor by uniqueness of left adjoints. For a compactification c and a Cartesian open square, define the source compact-support compositor, the proper restriction mate from the inverse-image compositor and direct-image counit, the open-square extension compositor, and the target compact-support restriction as their composite with the inverse open unit. For the trivial compactification identify compact-support image with open extension using the normalized derived identity. These are precisely the eight original canonical constructions of det-sf-mate-open-restriction, with their signatures and bodies unchanged. Notions and canonical constructions: [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [sk-def-localizing-closure], [sk-def-sfb-constructible], [det-sf-existence-brown], [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek], [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

source.place: Proof (1)--(2), exact open adjunctions and canonical comparison maps

proof.text: Use ObjectProperty.lift for the restricted functors. Use leftAdjointUniq and the coefficient-compatible pullback compositor for open extensions. Compose these with the canonical derived proper-image counit and inverse open unit in the actual pullback compactification. The identity proper-image comparison is normalized on ordinary module sheaves. All constructions are the original terms, without choosing functors from mere existence.
